title: The Great Pyramid of Giza (Pyramid of Cheops or Khufu) (14823042753).jpg
author: Jorge Láscar
credit: The Great Pyramid of Giza (Pyramid of Cheops or Khufu)
description: The Great Pyramid of Giza (also known as the Pyramid of Khufu or the Pyramid of Cheops) is the oldest and largest of the three pyramids in the Giza Necropolis bordering what is now El Giza, Egypt. It is the oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and the only one to remain largely intact.
